s1.lead: Meet da Tribu is the guide older students wish they had been given. Everything you need to make your first weeks at HEI count.

mission.title: The mission.
mission.text: AI, cyber and code, for jobs in Madagascar.

domains.title: Three fields.
domains.text: Cloud and cybersecurity, AI, software engineering.

s3.desc: Everyone starts with programming fundamentals, in Java and JavaScript. Then two paths: Software Ecosystem to build robust, secure applications, and Digital Transformation to make data work for businesses.

s4.desc: Every theoretical concept comes with a hands-on project. After three years in the LMD system: a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science recognised by MESupRES.

s1.title: Find the campus before day one.
s1.desc: II J 161 R, Ambodivoanjo, Ivandry. The front desk is open Monday to Friday, 8am-12pm and 1pm-4pm.
s1.imageAlt: The HEI building in Ivandry, seen from the entrance, with its white walkways

s2.title: On day one, it all starts at the front desk.
s2.desc: Arrive early, introduce yourself, save your classmates' contacts. Now is the time for the "silly" questions.
s2.imageAlt: HEI students in orange T-shirts around an HEI sign

s3.title: The LEI sets your foundations in two weeks.
s3.desc: L'École d'Informatique, mandatory for every first-year: the tools, HTML/CSS, and your class. The final project: your own survival guide.
s3.imageAlt: New students gathered during the welcome week

s4.title: The intranet runs your days.
s4.desc: Classes, rooms, announcements: everything goes through the intranet and Google Workspace. Make checking it a morning habit.
s4.imageAlt: An HEI classroom during a presentation

w1.hint: UNDERSTAND THE PROBLEM BEFORE WRITING A LINE

w2.hint: PRACTISE EVERY DAY, IN PROJECTS AND IN TEAMS

w3.hint: CHANGE THINGS, IN MADAGASCAR AND BEYOND

testimonial.label: A graduate's testimony
testimonial.quote: I landed my first job during my internship. In interviews, I had code to show: all my HEI projects.
testimonial.author: [First name L.], Mpamakilay class

footer.lead: Meet da Tribu gathers what older students wish they had known when they arrived at HEI. Free, no account, in French and English.
footer.tagline: The HEI survival guide, made during LEI 2026.

orbit.titleA: Before your first class, there is
orbit.lead: Over 350 students, clubs, hackathons, a class that helps each other. You are joining a family.
orbit.imageAlt: Hundreds of HEI students dancing together during the 2024 welcome week

a1.quote: I was afraid to ask questions.
a1.title: Ask them early.
a1.text: Nobody is waiting for you to fail: one question in week one saves you ten later.

a2.quote: I coded alone in my corner.
a2.title: Work in pairs.
a2.text: Explaining your code to someone is the best debugger. That's what the Tribe is for.

a3.quote: I found the intranet too late.
a3.title: Open the intranet every morning.
a3.text: Classes, rooms, announcements: it all goes through there. Two minutes a day is enough.

a4.title: Make AI your mentor.
a4.text: Ask it to explain, not to do it for you. What you understand, you keep.

a5.quote: I waited to feel ready before coding.
a5.title: Code a little every day.
a5.text: A Mimo exercise, an HTML page, a small project: consistency beats intensity.

tools.lead: What you'll open every day at HEI.

workspace.name: Google Workspace
workspace.what: Your online office: forms, shared documents, assignment submissions and remote classes.
workspace.tip: One Drive folder per course from day one, and you'll find everything in ten seconds at the end of the semester.

web.name: HTML/CSS and Mimo
web.what: Web basics, the ones the LEI project uses. Mimo, the app to practise a little every day.
web.tip: Ten minutes of Mimo on the bus are worth more than an all-nighter before the deadline.

ai.name: AI, your mentor
ai.what: To understand an error, a concept, an exercise. Not to do it for you.
ai.tip: Ask "explain why", never "do it". What you understand, you keep for the exam.

intranet.name: The HEI intranet
intranet.what: Timetable, rooms, announcements, grades: everything about your studies.
intranet.tip: A quick look every morning before you leave: that's where you learn a class has moved.
